dedupe_keys.name: grand unified magnetosphere ionosphere coupling simulation

description: GUMICS couples solar-wind and magnetosphere MHD with ionospheric electrostatics. Adaptive spatial and temporal methods support calculations over a global magnetospheric domain. The resource is documented by Finnish Meteorological Institute. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented release is historical and represents large-scale fluid behaviour, not all kinetic plasma processes. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
